place.summary: Hong Kong Island functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is ID. It receives notable inbound connections from Hong Kong Disneyland. Visitors often continue to Victoria Harbour. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.

opportunity_cards.title: Frequent companion: Hong Kong Disneyland
opportunity_cards.detail: Hong Kong Island frequently appears alongside Hong Kong Disneyland, suggesting cross-promotion or route packaging potential.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Lantau Island
opportunity_cards.detail: Visitors often continue from Hong Kong Island to Lantau Island, with relatively strong journey experience.

opportunity_cards.title: High visibility, weaker experience
opportunity_cards.detail: Hong Kong Island draws meaningful traffic but performs below its category average on experience.
